Subject: Benchmarking results: Hosted vs Dedicated vs Private (summary + attachments)

Hi Samir / Helen —

We completed the customer-run tests on 3/04 using the workload scripts you provided. Attached is a short results brief (benchmark_results-hosted-dedicated-private.pdf) and the raw CSVs. Key findings (high level):

1) Latency (chat prompts, <=128 tokens)
- Hosted (multi-tenant): P50 = 75ms, P95 = 380ms under concurrency 50; we observed occasional P95 spikes to ~620ms during noisy-hour windows (external co-tenants)
- Dedicated (single-tenant reserved pool): P50 = 68ms, P95 = 210ms under concurrency 50; highly stable across runs
- Private (on-prem staging): P50 = 90ms, P95 = 290ms but variance heavily tied to network egress and local GPU driver versioning on your staging nodes

2) TTFT (streaming first token)
- Hosted: median 110ms, spikes to 210ms under network contention
- Dedicated: median 95ms, consistent
- Private: median 130ms; tuning recommended (driver/kernel)

3) Sustained throughput (tokens/sec) at increasing concurrency
- Baseline (50 concurrent sessions): Hosted = 2,100 tps, Dedicated = 2,350 tps, Private = 1,800 tps
- Ramp test (200 concurrent sessions): Hosted saturates and shows queuing at ~3,500 concurrent requests with P95>900ms; Dedicated continued linearly to capacity with P95<=250ms until we hit reserved GPU throughput cap; Private performance depends on provisioning — we tested 4xA100 equiv and saw throughput ~2,700 tps but with p95s creeping up when memory pressure increased

4) Autoscaling behavior
- Hosted: quick burst capacity for small bursts, but observed longer tails when platform-wide utilization is high; warmup/scale-out to high sustained capacity can take 2–4 minutes depending on region and instance availability
- Dedicated: autoscale policies (reserved + burst) hit target within ~60–110s consistently; predictable because workloads stay within your reserved pool
- Private: entirely dependent on your k8s/autoscaler config; in our test your cluster scaled from 2->8 nodes in ~150s but node provisioning time on-prem was the dominant factor

5) Isolation & predictability
- Dedicated gave best isolation and lowest tail variance. Hosted is cost-effective and fast to start but has higher tail variance under platform-wide load. Private provides maximum data control but requires ops investment to match Dedicated predictability.

Recommendations (MAP actionable items):
- Acceptance criteria updates: set P95 threshold for Hosted at 450ms to account for platform tail risk; set Dedicated SLA target P95 <= 250ms
- For Private: we recommend matching driver/kernel versions and using our config template to keep P95 under 300ms
- Autoscale SLA: Dedicated to be the primary choice for predictable production SLAs; Hosted acceptable for non-critical/early-stage usage with canary routing to Dedicated in incidents
